Bitolea is highly diversified in terms of waste sourcing industries, clients’ end markets (automotive, chemical, cleaning, paints, inks, and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients) and geographical presence. muzinich-co.name: Surfaces Technological Abrasives

The Group has over 200 FTEs and is headquartered in Cenate di Sotto (Bergamo - Northern Italy) with production facilities and warehouses also in Sassuolo (Modena – Center of Italy), where one of the major ceramic districts is located, and in Thiene (Vicenza – Northeast of Italy). Region: Italy Sector: Industrial Goods Date of Investment: October 2017 Website: http://www.surfaces-group.it/

muzinich-co.name: Gotha Cosmetics

muzinich-co.name: SIT Group

Main product segments include gas valves, electronic boards, sensors, fans and flue exhausts. SIT's current production footprint is distributed across five main countries (Italy, Romania, Mexico, China and Netherlands) and employs c. 1,900 people. Region: Italy Sector: Industrial Goods Date of Investment: July 2016 Website: http://www.sitgroup.it/

Customers are offered a one-stop-shop experience with a wide range of SKUs across multiple product categories (furniture, lighting, accessories and outdoor) and with different styles. Eichholtz operates an asset light business model and is headquartered in Noordwijkerhout (NL) where it has a grand showroom and warehouse, with additional showrooms in High Point (US) and Amsterdam (NL). In addition, Eichholtz has partnerships with dozens of Eichholtz monobrand stores that are located around the world.

rivean-capital.name: Ace Pharmaceuticals
rivean-capital.description: Ace Pharmaceuticals (Ace) is a leading independent pharmaceutical company operating in the niche market of medical need products to satisfy the unmet demand of small patient groups. By doing this, the company makes a valuable contribution to society. Via its state-of-the-art facility, Ace carries out the development, production, and distribution of its products. In addition, Ace manufactures and distributes pharmaceutical compounded products for pharmacies.

rivean-capital.name: STAEDEAN
rivean-capital.description: STAEDEAN is a leading developer of SaaS business application software based on Microsoft ERP solutions for the manufacturing, life sciences and equipment rental verticals. It serves a global (45+ countries) and diversified (2.2k+) customer base, primarily through a network of channel partners. As an Inner Circle Partner (top 1%) for 19+ years, STAEDEAN is widely recognized as a top 5 global independent software vendor (ISV) in the Microsoft ecosystem.

rivean-capital.name: TAS
rivean-capital.description: TAS is a leading developer of software solutions and services for a niche of the financial services sector, focusing on card management, interbank payments, capital markets and open banking (PSD2). It provides mission critical software solutions linking into the core banking platforms of c.90% of all Italian financial institutions, as well as professional services related to ongoing maintenance, new regulation, and implementations. Besides Italy, TAS has operations across Europe with a specific focus on DACH and Eastern Europe.

rivean-capital.name: EDCO
rivean-capital.description: EDCO is a leading and fast-growing distributor of value- and branded non-food FMCG products to a wide variety of retailers. Products and services are offered to a broad customer base (+3k customers) consisting of different archetype retailers including food discounters, discount non-food, super/hyper markets, small independents, specialists and e-commerce. Over the last years, EDCO has transformed from a family led, trading business to a value-added (multicategory) distributor with a significantly increased focus on brands and retail concepts.

rivean-capital.name: TenCate Grass
rivean-capital.description: TenCate Grass (“TCGrass”) is the global leader in the design, manufacture, distribution and installation of artificial turf solutions for both sports and landscaping. The Company operates a vertically integrated business model from grass yarn extrusion and backing fabrics manufacturing (“Upstream”) extending through turf manufacturing (tufting, weaving) and distribution (“Midstream”), through to end product installation and maintenance (“Downstream”), serving a globally diversified customer base at each level of the value chain, which consists of leading tufting & distribution companies, landscaping and sports installers and product end users.

rivean-capital.name: Corilus
rivean-capital.description: Corilus is the market leader in Belgium in integrated healthcare software and IT solutions for a wide range of medical and paramedical professionals including general practitioners, dentists, elderly homes, physiotherapists, nurses, pharmacies, etc. The Company’s software solutions aim to facilitate increased efficiency in the day-to-day administrative and clinical operations as well as collaboration across stakeholders (e.g. caretakers, hospitals). Corilus offers its solutions to over 13,000 clients, representing over 40,000 users.

rivean-capital.name: XD Connects
rivean-capital.description: XD Connects is a leading designer and value-added supplier of sustainable business gifts, serving over 5,000 B2B-distributors, mainly in Europe. XD Connects has two main goals: becoming a CO2 neutral company in 2030 through carbon offsetting, and more importantly continuously reducing the CO2 footprint in both its product collection and operations. Headquartered in Rijswijk, the Netherlands, XD Connects operates an inhouse printing and fulfillment center in Romania, as well as a design studio and sourcing office in Shanghai. The company markets its products through a network of sales entities globally, focusing on the European market.

rivean-capital.name: TenCate Geosynthetics
rivean-capital.description: TenCate Geosynthetics is the global leading manufacturer of geotextiles, with applications in civil works, infrastructure and water & environment as well as niche applications in industrial fabrics. Products are used for separation, drainage and filtration purposes, as well as erosion and shoreline protection, land reclamation and reinforcement of dikes and dams. The Company employs +1,400 FTE across 8 manufacturing facilities in North America (2 incl. HQ), Europe (3) and Asia (3). TenCate Geosynthetics was sold to Solmax in May 2021.

rivean-capital.name: TenCate Advanced Armour
rivean-capital.description: TenCate Advanced Armour (“TCAA”) develops and produces lightweight composites and ceramic materials for ballistic protection of personnel and vehicles, aircraft and ships in the key end-markets defence and law enforcement. Main products are tailormade spall liner and add-on armour kits for various parts of vehicles, helicopters, and airplanes as well as a wide range of high spec ballistic plates for body armour (vests, shields).

rivean-capital.name: Enstall
rivean-capital.description: Enstall is the global leading developer and distributor of solar panel mounting systems for both residential and commercial roofs. Its in-house R&D team develops innovative and user-friendly systems, characterized by their ease to install and reliability. Production is outsourced to third parties and products are subsequently distributed to wholesalers, EPC contractors, solar integrators or installers directly.

rivean-capital.name: Powerlines
rivean-capital.description: Engineering provider for energy technology infrastructure

rivean-capital.name: Muon
rivean-capital.description: Muon is a global leader in mission-critical micro precision solutions functioning at the heart of end user applications in healthcare, semiconductor, digital printing and filtration. With its comprehensive portfolio of miniaturization technologies, consisting of electroforming, micromechanical and thermal processing, chemical etching and laser material processing, Muon is uniquely positioned to supply these components to the world’s most demanding, high-tech OEMs.

rivean-capital.name: KINKELDER
rivean-capital.description: KINKELDER is a developer, manufacturer and distributor of high-quality circular saw blades applied in industrial high-speed steel cutting processes and is the global leader in this market. KINKELDER produces blades in three locations in Europe and the US, from which it exports to over 70 countries. The company has an unmatched reputation for high quality & service and a continuous focus on innovation.

rivean-capital.name: ELCEE
rivean-capital.description: ELCEE is a leading supplier of customized parts and components, assembled products and standard products for a wide range of industrial markets. The company is active in the (co-)development, design, engineering and supply chain management (sourcing, stock-keeping as well as quality control and delivery) of industrial parts in four product groups: castings and forgings, plain bearings, fasteners, and lifters. ELCEE operates local offices throughout Europe in combination with technical support centers in China and Poland.

rivean-capital.name: ZND
rivean-capital.description: ZND is a leading manufacturer of temporary fences (panels and barriers) for construction and event markets. The Company runs a highly efficient and fully automated production process and sell to distributors and rental companies arround the globe. ZND is a market leader in the United States and various European countries with production facilities in the US (2), the United Kingdom, the Netherlands, and Poland.

rivean-capital.name: Storio
rivean-capital.description: The merger of albelli and Photobox (completed Jan ‘22) has established the leading B2C e-commerce photo products & gifting business in Europe: Storio group. The group supplies high-quality photobooks and other related photo print products such as wall décor, cards, calendars, prints and goodies to millions of customers via highly recognized local brands and strong market positions across the Benelux, UK, France, Spain, Germany and Scandinavia as well as other European countries. Storio group operates a vertically integrated business model, combining e-commerce with inhouse printing and photo creation software, but also collaborates with networked external factories.

rivean-capital.name: TenCate Advanced Composites
rivean-capital.description: TenCate Advanced Composites (“TCAC”) is a leading global producer of advanced thermoplastic (TP) and thermoset (TS) composites. TCAC supplies TP composites to commercial aviation programs including Airbus and Boeing who are increasingly replacing traditional materials with TP as a means of reducing costs and enabling higher build rates on current and next-generation programs. In addition, TCAC has leading positions in high-value, attractive niche TS markets including Space & Communications and Industrial end-markets (specialty automotive). The Company employs over 700 FTE globally and operates manufacturing facilities in North America (3 incl. HQ), Europe (2), and Asia (1). TenCate Advanced Composites was sold to Toray in July 2018.

rivean-capital.name: TenCate Protective Fabrics
rivean-capital.description: TenCate Protective Fabrics designs, develops, manufactures, sources and sells fabrics used by garment makers for high-performance (protective) clothing. The fabrics provide protection against flame, heat, molten metal, chemical and other acids, achieved by strong know-how in blending fibres to incorporate, often patented, functionalities. TCPF is active in four segments; Industrial Safety (US, EMEA & APAC), Emergency Response (US, EMEA & APAC), Military (US, EMEA & APAC), and Workwear (EMEA).

rivean-capital.name: TenCate (Group/Holding)
rivean-capital.description: TenCate is a Dutch industrial conglomerate active in various areas of the technical textiles and composite materials universe. The group comprises five market groups active in (aero)space composites, antiballistics & armour, protective fabrics, synthetic grass and geosynthetics that operate largely on a stand-alone basis, supplying different products into different end markets. The holding is headquartered in the Netherlands with the individual (head-)offices and production sites located globally.

fund_portfolio_notes.canova-sgr: Canova SGR is a newly established Italian venture capital firm (authorized by the Bank of Italy in June 2023) currently in the early deployment phase of its first fund, Nova 1, targeting €45M for Italian Seed and Series A investments in AI/ML, Blockchain, Deeptech, IoT, and Cybersecurity. Known strategic positions include participation in Eterna Capital Fund III (blockchain) and a partnership with VeniSIA (Venice Sustainability Innovation Accelerator) for deeptech and sustainability startups. Direct portfolio company names are not yet publicly disclosed.
